messages:
DeployBot: rollout complete: runtime v3.14.2 -> prod (100% traffic) at 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z
Alex: heads-up: API /v1/generate p99 jumped from ~420ms to ~980ms starting ~13:58 UTC, p95 up ~2x too. Not seeing error rate spike.
Maya: saw that on dashboards, mostly on long-sequence requests (>1024 tokens). link: https://grafana.redwood/p/abc123/runtime-p95
Sam: is canary still showing green? I thought we had 10% canary for this rollout.
Priya: canary metrics (10%) looked fine for 2h earlier. The full rollout included a config change we didn't vet in canary: sched.prefetch_window=8 (was 4).
Alex: that config tweak would increase prefetching of KV/cache windows — could increase kernel queueing for long sequences.
Maya: traces show increased kernel_queue_wait and higher inter-op latency on the runtime host. example span: kernel.queue_wait.ms ~ 250 -> 700.
Sam: quick mitigation: can we pin traffic back to v3.14.1 while we investigate?
DeployBot: rollback started: shifting 100% -> v3.14.1 over 3m.
OpsBot: rollback progress: 60% -> 90% -> 100%.
Maya: p99 started to drop within ~90s of rollback start, down to ~460ms now. p95 back near baseline.
Priya: good. We should bisect to confirm prefetch_window is the culprit before re-rolling. Can someone grab the exact commit(s) that changed default?
Alex: commit list for v3.14.2: 9f2a1c4 (sched: prefetch window), b7d0c12 (docs), 2c4d999 (minor telemetry). 9f2a1c4 is the likely suspect.
Sam: Plan: 1) rollback stays in place 2) reproduce locally with long sequence workload using v3.14.2 + sched.prefetch_window=8 3) run controlled canary with 1% traffic and extra telemetry (kernel queue histograms) 4) if reproduced, implement adaptive backoff or revert change.
Alex: reproduction curl (low-fidelity) for stress test:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input": "long prompt..."}' & done; wait
```
Maya: also capture tcpdump and host-level iowait/irq stats during repro, but primary signal is kernel_queue_wait.
Priya: I'll open an internal postmortem stub and tag customer-success for any escalations. If customers reported latency, ops should notify.
Sam: also verify no other simultaneous rollouts (infra, scheduler binary). I checked: only this runtime config bump landed at ~13:57.
Alex: adding a temporary traffic policy to route latency-sensitive tenants to v3.14.1 until we have a safe fix. I created route override: `routing.policy.override: tenant_id in ["acme", "payco"] -> v3.14.1`
Maya: thumbs up. Next steps: Priya to own bisect + repro, Alex to own route override + incident comms, Sam to validate binary-only repro.
Priya: assigned, starting bisect now. Will post repro artifacts and traces in this thread. :eyes:
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread about p95/p99 regression after runtime rollout; follows agents.md schema requirements (channel, timestamps, participants, continuous messages string).
